package.name: kinect_audio_cpp
package.description:
C++ ROS 2 Jazzy driver for the Kinect v1 microphone array and tilt/accel. Uses the libfreenect C API directly.
Nodes: kinect_audio – 4-ch mic array (libfreenect audio API) kinect_tilt_accel – tilt motor + accelerometer (1473 and 1414 compatible)
Published topics (kinect_audio): /kinect/audio/raw std_msgs/Int32MultiArray 4-ch int32 mic data /kinect/audio/cancelled std_msgs/Int16MultiArray HW noise-cancelled int16 /kinect/audio/info std_msgs/String JSON metadata
Published topics (kinect_tilt_accel): /kinect/tilt_angle std_msgs/Float32 degrees /kinect/accel geometry_msgs/Vector3 m/s² /kinect/imu/data sensor_msgs/Imu full IMU msg
Subscribed topics (kinect_tilt_accel): /kinect/tilt_cmd std_msgs/Float32 desired tilt degrees
